items.title: American Airlines Seeks Widebody Order to Take On Delta and United
items.summary: Ordering more widebodies would allow American to invest in more international growth — a key market that has fueled the profits of chief rivals Delta and United.

items.title: Airfares Are Up 20%, Demand Is Strong. Even Airline CEOs Are Surprised.
items.summary: Airlines across the world have been cutting capacity and raising airfares to keep up with higher fuel costs. But even as travel is becoming more expensive, consumers still want to spend.

items.title: The World Cup Promised to Go Green. This One Could Be the Most Carbon-Heavy Ever
items.summary: Transportation is the main problem. Progress in emission reductions at the World Cup would come from concentrating future tournaments in single countries.

items.title: Vrbo Is Launching Sponsored Listings — with Expedia.com Placements to Come

items.title: GMH Hotels: Hotel AI Is Cutting Costs. It Should Be Making Money.

items.title: How Curation and Scale Battle for Dominance Inside the World’s Busiest Airport Hubs
items.summary: Each Gulf hub airport converts sovereign wealth into a different theory of national relevance. Saudi Arabia is about to test whether aviation can convert something heavier — national ambition itself — into a destination economy.

items.title: Skift Global Forum 2026: The Decisions on the Table
